prompt:
Implement this service.

<spec>
name: node-heartbeat-monitor
description: Nodes post heartbeats; a node is stale if it has not been heard from
  recently.
endpoints:
- method: GET
  path: /health
- method: GET
  path: /metrics
- method: POST
  path: /heartbeat
  description: 'body {node: non-empty string}; 204 on success; 400 if node missing
    or malformed JSON'
- method: GET
  path: /nodes
  description: '200 JSON list of {node, status: healthy|stale, last_seen: RFC3339}'
- method: GET
  path: /nodes/{node}
  description: 200 one node object; 404 if unknown
metrics:
- name: nodes_healthy
  type: gauge
  help: Nodes with a recent heartbeat
- name: nodes_stale
  type: gauge
  help: Nodes with no recent heartbeat
behaviors:
- A node is stale when its last heartbeat is older than STALE_AFTER_SECONDS (env var,
  default 30)
- A background goroutine recomputes the two gauges every second; stop it cleanly (no
  goroutine required to stop for tests)
probes:
- method: POST
  path: /heartbeat
  expect_status:
  - 200
  - 204
  body: '{"node": "n1"}'
- method: POST
  path: /heartbeat
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{}'
- method: GET
  path: /nodes
  expect_status:
  - 200
- method: GET
  path: /nodes/n1
  expect_status:
  - 200
- method: GET
  path: /nodes/unknown
  expect_status:
  - 404
</spec>

Already provided by templates (do NOT write or register these):
- main.go: `func newServer() http.Handler` serves GET /health and GET /metrics, then calls
  `registerRoutes(mux)`. Do not register /health or /metrics yourself.
- metrics.go: Prometheus variables you must keep up to date from your handlers:
- nodesHealthy  (gauge) -> exposed as `nodes_healthy`; use Set/Inc/Dec/Add
- nodesStale  (gauge) -> exposed as `nodes_stale`; use Set/Inc/Dec/Add

You must write these files:
1. handlers.go - defines `func registerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux)` that registers ONLY these routes:
   - POST /heartbeat  body {node: non-empty string}; 204 on success; 400 if node missing or malformed JSON
   - GET /nodes  200 JSON list of {node, status: healthy|stale, last_seen: RFC3339}
   - GET /nodes/{node}  200 one node object; 404 if unknown
   Keep state in memory (you may add store.go). Return JSON with proper status codes; reject
   malformed input with 400. The behaviors in the spec are verified at runtime.
2. handlers_test.go - at least 3 `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` functions using
   net/http/httptest against `newServer()`. Never bind real ports; tests must finish in seconds.
3. README.md - must contain: an "## Endpoints" section listing EVERY spec endpoint (including
   /health and /metrics) as `METHOD /path` in backticks, and a "## Metrics" section listing EVERY
   metric name in backticks. Only document things that actually exist.
